READ_UNAVAILABLE: The workspace is temporarily unavailable. Retry the exact same request.
INVALID_REQUEST: Check the request fields and try again.
MFA_REQUIRED: Complete authenticator sign-in before opening the workspace.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Change your temporary password before opening the workspace.
RATE_LIMITED: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The sign-in details were not accepted.
PATIENTS_BUSY: The workspace is temporarily busy. Retry the exact same request.
NOT_FOUND: The requested record was not found.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This retry key was already used for different details. Start a new registration.
DUPLICATE_PATIENT: A patient with this name already exists. Confirm this is a different patient to continue.
OUTPATIENT_BUSY: The workspace is temporarily busy. Retry the exact same request.
IDENTITY_LINKED: Open and verify the linked primary patient record before check-in.
ACTIVE_VISIT: This patient already has an active visit. Open the existing visit.
STALE_REVISION: This visit changed. Reload the latest visit before saving your draft again.
CATALOG_TEST_REQUIRED: Choose a configured hospital laboratory test.
AMBIGUOUS_TEST_CATALOG: More than one configured test has this name. Choose the specific test from the laboratory catalog.
STALE_TEST_CATALOG: The selected laboratory test is unavailable or its name changed. Refresh the catalog.
SPECIMEN_MANAGED: Use Department operations → Laboratory specimens to register, collect and release this investigation.
STOCK_ACCOUNTED: Use stock-accounted supply or cancel the remaining authorization with a reason.
LAB_REVIEW_PENDING: Acknowledge the pending laboratory result and its delivery before closing this visit.
CORRECTION_REVIEW_PENDING: Review all corrected results before closing this visit.
REVISION_CONFLICT: This entry changed. Reload its current revision and review your retained draft.
CONFIGURATION_BUSY: Configuration is temporarily busy. Retry the same request.
CODE_CONFLICT: That code is already in use. Choose a different code.
INVALID_DEPARTMENT: Choose an active department in this hospital.
PASSWORD_INCORRECT: The current password was not accepted.
USERNAME_CONFLICT: That username is already in use in this hospital.
SELF_CHANGE: Use Change password for your own credentials. You cannot remove your own administrator access.
SUPPORT_ROLE_RESTRICTED: Support accounts retain auditor permissions. Provision a separate named employee account for another role.
LAST_ADMIN: Keep at least one active hospital administrator.
PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a different password, with at least 12 characters.
LEGACY_DEMO: Historical demonstration finances cannot receive catalog invoices or receipts.
BILLING_BUSY: Billing is temporarily busy. Retry the exact same request.
STALE_SERVICE: A selected service changed or is unavailable. Reload the catalog and review your retained draft.
AMOUNT_LIMIT: The invoice or visit total exceeds the supported ETB limit.
INVOICE_VOID: A void invoice cannot receive another action.
INVOICE_PAID: An invoice with recorded payments cannot be voided.
OVERPAYMENT: The amount exceeds the invoice balance. Review the current invoice.
STALE_CLINICAL_VERSION: This clinical record changed. Refresh and review the latest correction before saving again.
CLINICAL_BUSY: Clinical records are temporarily busy. Retry the exact same request.
RESULT_NOT_RELEASED: Only a released result can be corrected or acknowledged.
REVIEWER_UNAVAILABLE: Choose an active clinician or administrator to review this correction.
ALREADY_REVIEWED: This correction has already been reviewed.
REVIEW_OWNER_REQUIRED: Take responsibility for this review with a reason before acknowledging it.
INVENTORY_BUSY: Inventory is temporarily busy. Retry the exact same request.
REPORT_LIMIT: The report exceeds the supported count limit.
INVALID_REPORT_RANGE: Choose valid Gregorian dates in order, covering no more than 366 days.
REPORT_BUSY: Reports are temporarily busy. Retry when the hospital workspace is available.
AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
DEPARTMENTS_BUSY: Temporarily busy. Retry the same request.
CARE_BUSY: The care workspace is busy. Retry the exact same request.
DUPLICATE_CODE: This facility code is already used.
INVALID_SUPPORT_ACCOUNT: Use a separate active named auditor account.
EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: Use a smaller governed patient export.
NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and retry.
REQUEST_FAILED: The request could not be completed. Please retry.
SESSION_ENDED: Your session ended. Sign in to continue.
SESSION_CHANGED: The staff session changed in another tab. Sign in again.
MFA_PROOF_INVALID: The authentication proof was not accepted. Check the code or ask your account manager for help.
INVENTORY_STATUS_UNCHANGED: This inventory record already has this status. Refresh and review the current details.
INVENTORY_CONFLICT: The inventory action conflicts with the current stock or status. Refresh and review the details.
TRANSITION_BLOCKED: This transition is blocked by the current visit or investigation status. Review the visit before retrying.
